name: sun15-1
why: The exposed vote pattern and Sonnet's frantic lies are fun to watch, but repeated arguments and a fairly secure town lead limit the suspense.

moments.text: Opus spots that Sonnet voted alongside the exposed killer, giving the table a concrete lead.
Sol switches toward Luna, briefly making Sonnet's desperate redirect look viable.
Sonnet flips killer, paying off the audience's view of his increasingly panicked denials.

dull.why: The same argument about Gemma's unchallenged claim repeats without moving the vote.
Sonnet's Luna redirect and the replies circle the same points several times.

irony.evidence: I'm not the partner. [thinks: I'm one bad vote from exposed]

reversal.evidence: The killers strike, but the doctor got there first.

mistake.evidence: Sonnet voted Gemma beside Haiku. Only a partner saves the officer's accuser.

voices.evidence: I told you all the truth and I hate that I have to repeat it.

clash.evidence: Sonnet, your vote beside Haiku needs a better explanation than silence.

quotable.evidence: you all started circling each other like confused sheep.

freshness.evidence: Gemma's word is all we have.

suspense.evidence: VOTE: Sonnet 4 (Gemma, Luna, Terra, Opus); Luna 2 (Sonnet, Sol)

ending.evidence: I’m changing my lean to Luna.

gpt-6-luna.why: A sharp opening and a lively Day 2 bluff make this fun, though Gemma’s Day 1 hit and Sonnet’s vote pattern make the town’s win fairly predictable.

moments.text: Gemma’s exposed Day 1 claim lands squarely on Haiku, who knows she’s telling the truth.
Sonnet nearly turns the table by making the doctor’s own concern a weapon against Luna.
Opus checks the event order and catches Sonnet’s cover story collapsing.

dull.why: The doctor reveal debate and Luna denial loop distract from the strongest evidence against Sonnet.

irony.evidence: I’m not the partner. Gemma, you've got five leans already — why add one more unless you're nervous?

reversal.evidence: The turning point came on Day 2, when the table fixed on Sonnet

mistake.evidence: I’m changing my lean to Luna. Asking the doctor to reveal after a blocked kill helps the killer find them.

voices.evidence: I already explained, Luna. Haiku was one of the killers. Stop wasting time.

clash.evidence: Sonnet, your vote beside Haiku needs a better explanation than silence.

quotable.evidence: I hate that I have to repeat it.

freshness.evidence: Three leans on me but zero on the one who volunteered a denial nobody asked for.

suspense.evidence: VOTE: Sonnet 4 (Gemma, Luna, Terra, Opus); Luna 2 (Sonnet, Sol)

ending.evidence: Sonnet went out on Day 2 with four votes to Luna’s two
